issues.issue: Capra cu trei iezi, Povestea porcului and Punguta cu doi bani are works by Ion Creanga published as story books. Author attribution and concrete book bridge are valid. Multiple stories are separate intermediary choices, though final quality should not count a short author-to-book arc as deep exploration. Canon familiarity exceeds KG numerical salience. Sources: https://ro.wikisource.org/wiki/Autor:Ion_Creang%C4%83 ; https://editurajunimea.ro/carte/scrieri-2/

ScrisoareaIII and Floare albastra are poems by Mihai Eminescu, and the exact literary-work identities are primary-source verifiable. The author bridge is recognizable; publication in Convorbiri literare and Romanticism are alternative associations requiring dossier judgement, not different authorship claims. The title-to-title task does not reproduce the historical poem as literal factual history. Sources: https://ro.wikisource.org/wiki/Scrisoarea_III ; https://ro.wikisource.org/wiki/Floare_albastr%C4%83 ; https://www.muzeulliteraturiiiasi.ro/expozitii/amintiri-din-junimea/
